10.name: Tony Pollard
10.comment: Pollard will have a chance to easily pace the Titans backfield against Cincinnati on Sunday due to the absence of Tyjae Spears (knee), Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

10.name: Tyjae Spears
10.comment: Spears (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Bengals.

10.name: Carnell Tate
10.comment: Tate (shoulder) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Bengals, Ben Arthur of FoxSports.com reports.

10.name: Jaylon Jones
10.comment: questionable

10.name: Jonah Laulu
10.comment: The Titans claimed Laulu off waivers from the Raiders on Wednesday, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

10.name: Amani Hooker
10.comment: Hooker posted five tackles (two solo) during Sunday's 27-24 loss to Cleveland.

10.name: Kevin Winston Jr.
10.comment: Winston logged 14 tackles (eight solo) during the Titans' 27-24 loss to the Browns on Sunday.

10.name: Anthony Hill Jr.
10.comment: Hill logged 12 tackles (five solo) and one forced fumble during the Titans' 27-24 loss to the Browns on Sunday.

10.name: Gunnar Helm
10.comment: Helm caught three of four targets for 24 yards in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Browns.

10.name: Cam Ward
10.comment: Ward completed 20 of 31 passes for 181 yards with an interception in Sunday's 27-24 loss to Cleveland. He added five yards on two carries.

10.name: Joey Slye
10.comment: Slye made his only field-goal attempt while going 3-for-3 on extra-point tries during Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Browns.

10.name: Tony Adams
10.comment: Adams (ankle) is active for Sunday's game against the Browns.

10.name: Timmy Horne
10.comment: The Titans signed Horne from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Jim Wyatt of the team's official site reports.

10.name: Dorian Mausi
10.comment: The Titans opened Mausi's 21-day practice window Wednesday, Jim Wyatt of the team's official website reports.

10.name: Joshua Williams
10.comment: The Titans activated Williams (pectoral) from reserve/PUP on Saturday.

28.name: Daron Payne
28.comment: Payne (foot) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Eagles.

28.name: Jer'Zhan Newton
28.comment: Newton (pectoral) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Eagles.

28.name: Javon Kinlaw
28.comment: Kinlaw (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Eagles.

28.name: John Bates
28.comment: Bates (shoulder) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Eagles.

28.name: Treylon Burks
28.comment: Burks (foot) is questionable for Sunday night's game against the Eagles.

28.name: Terry McLaurin
28.comment: McLaurin (knee) underwent surgery Friday to repair the torn patellar tendon in his left knee, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

28.name: Stefon Diggs
28.comment: Diggs (hand/hamstring) was a full practice participant Thursday.

28.name: Laremy Tunsil
28.comment: Tunsil (triceps) could potentially return late in the season, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

28.name: Van Jefferson
28.comment: The Commanders signed Jefferson to the active roster Wednesday, Zach Selby of the team's official site reports.

28.name: Marcus Mariota
28.comment: Mariota (knee) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice.

28.name: Antonio Williams
28.comment: Coach Dan Quinn noted Monday that with Terry McLaurin (knee) out for the season, Stefon Diggs' workload isn't expected to change much, however others, notably Williams, should see added opportunities in McLaurin's looming absence, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

28.name: Jaylin Lane
28.comment: Lane underwent surgery Oct. 9 to repair his fractured and dislocated ankle, and he is expected to be cleared for activities before OTAs, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.

28.name: Sonny Styles
28.comment: Styles finished Monday's 23-17 loss to the 49ers with 13 tackles (seven solo) and one pass defense.

28.name: Drew Stevens
28.comment: Stevens made his only field-goal try and converted both of his extra-point attempts during Monday's 23-17 loss at San Francisco.

28.name: Austin Ekeler
28.comment: Ekeler logged a three-yard carry and caught both of his targets for four yards during the Commanders' 23-17 loss to the 49ers on Monday.

28.name: Dyami Brown
28.comment: Brown hauled in his only target for six yards during Monday's 23-17 loss versus San Francisco.

28.name: Jeremy McNichols
28.comment: McNichols accrued five rushes for 13 yards during Monday's 23-17 loss to the 49ers.

28.name: Charles Omenihu
28.comment: questionable

28.name: Chig Okonkwo
28.comment: Okonkwo brought in all seven targets for 69 yards in the Commanders' 23-17 loss to the 49ers on Monday night.

28.name: Rachaad White
28.comment: White rushed seven times for 27 yards and brought in four of five targets for 30 yards and a touchdown in the Commanders' 23-17 loss to the 49ers on Monday night.
